title: Lower t-structure bounds detected by morphism vanishing
statement: Let $\mathcal T$ be a triangulated category equipped with a t-structure $t$ [def-weil-t-structure], let $a\in\mathbf Z$, and let $M\in\mathcal T$. Then $M\in\mathcal T^{\ge a}$ if and only if, for every $A\in\mathcal T^{\le a-1}$, every morphism $A\to M$ is zero. No boundedness or nondegeneracy of the t-structure is assumed.
